description: Selects which of two sources feeds the load of a power mux, or reads which one is on.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled: the source is switched when it changes, a reading on every pass.

fields.description: What the block does once when it stops being enabled.

options.description: Leave the mux as it is.

variants.description: Feeds the load from nothing, source A or source B. At most one source is on: a change switches the old one off first and the new one on after the device's delay.
Reads which source is on: off, source A or source B.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled.
